name: Genspark
desc: AI workspace covering slides, docs, images, video, code.
desc_zh: 幻灯片、文档、图像、视频、代码都在里面的 AI 工作空间。
solves: A task that needs research, then a sheet, then slides gets handed back half-finished at every step. Genspark dispatches multiple agents to finish it between them.
solves_zh: 一件要查资料、再做表、再做幻灯片的活，每一步都只交一半。Genspark 派多个智能体分头做完。
best_for: You want the finished file — a deck, a sheet, a report — not an answer in chat.
best_for_zh: 你要的是一份成品文件——演示稿、表格、报告——不是聊天框里的一段回答。
notes: Pivoted from AI search to a general agent platform in 2025 and hit unicorn valuation on revenue growth, not demos. 首次公开发布日期精度：month-only 来源：https://techcrunch.com/2024/06/18/genspark-is-the-latest-attempt-at-an-ai-powered-search-engine/
